description: Core consumer services re-homed onto remaining Yandex DCs (incl. undamaged Kaluga modules) with priority by usage
evidence_for: Yandex: Alice, Mail, Maps, Search, Taxi restored first (A)
evidence_against_or_unknown: Surviving capacity unknown; AS200350 reachability not recovering by 19 Oct (B)
observable_indicators: Status page zones returning; IODA AS200350 recovery; new BGP announcements (AS200350 +32 prefixes from 17 Oct 17:20 UTC - unexplained)
constraints: Remaining capacity after losing 2 sites and part of a third
sources: https://www.theregister.com/security/2026/10/12/ukrainian-drone-strikes-on-yandex-datacenters-knock-cloud-and-payments-offline/5302577 | IODA API v2, own pull 2026-10-19 (api.ioda.inetintel.cc.gatech.edu/v2) - raw JSON in repo

description: Yandex Cloud customers moved to Selectel, K2Cloud, VK Cloud under an accelerated-migration arrangement
evidence_for: Agreement with Selectel, K2Cloud, VK Cloud (RBC via Svoboda; Kommersant); Yandex advised customers to move hosting (A); ProgressMe relaunched on new capacity (A)
evidence_against_or_unknown: Number of migrated clients not published
observable_indicators: Competitor capacity announcements; customer status notices; cloud price changes
constraints: Data-localisation rules keep data in Russia; competitor spare capacity limited

scenario: Commercial retention while capacity is rebuilt
description: Fee waivers and incentives to keep customers during outage
evidence_for: Yandex Cloud fees waived for existing clients 8-31 Oct; Yandex 360 free to end Oct; Saver rate raised; no penalty interest (via Svoboda)
observable_indicators: Extension or end of waivers after 31 Oct; churn reports

description: Repair buildings and replace equipment at damaged sites
evidence_for: Kommersant source: replacement equipment up to 6 months
evidence_against_or_unknown: Yandex cannot yet confirm Sasovo equipment is restorable (A); 5 of 9 Vladimir buildings damaged (RFE/RL imagery via Militarnyi)
observable_indicators: Construction activity on imagery; procurement news; Yandex statements on site status

description: Government brokers capacity for critical systems hosted on Yandex Cloud
evidence_for: Minister Shadayev: state helped find capacity for moving key systems (via Svoboda)

description: Personal data hosted in foreign DCs
evidence_for: AKIT trade association asked government to allow foreign DCs for Russians' personal data
evidence_against_or_unknown: Rules unchanged; lawyer: firms cannot move client archives abroad
assessment_basis: Analyst estimate based on reported regulatory position

description: Services already run from Sber's other DCs; Balakovo only partly commissioned
evidence_for: Sber: all services normal (A); experts: DB access via other DCs (D)
observable_indicators: Sber service status; no Sber-attributable outages

scenario: Delay or relocation of planned Balakovo workloads
description: Commissioning (planned 2027) and GosTech hosting plans pushed back or moved
observable_indicators: Revised commissioning date; GosTech hosting announcements; construction progress on imagery

description: Traffic served from other VK sites while the struck site's address space is dark
evidence_for: VK: services available as normal (A); IODA AS47541 -48% and not recovered (B) - consistent with failover
evidence_against_or_unknown: Which VK facility was hit; damage extent
constraints: Capacity headroom at other VK sites
sources: https://habr.com/ru/news/1095754/ | IODA API v2, own pull 2026-10-19 (api.ioda.inetintel.cc.gatech.edu/v2) - raw JSON in repo

scenario: Power-driven degradation rather than DC damage
description: Outage caused by damage to adjacent 330 kV Vostochnaya substation / grid, not the DC itself
evidence_for: Substation reportedly struck; ~20,000 residents lost power (governor)
evidence_against_or_unknown: No damage assessment of the DC
observable_indicators: IODA recovery timed with grid restoration

scenario: VK Cloud as both migration target and target of strikes
description: VK Cloud absorbs Yandex Cloud customers while VK infrastructure is itself struck
evidence_for: VK Cloud named in Yandex migration arrangement
evidence_against_or_unknown: Effect on VK Cloud capacity unknown

scenario: Cloud capacity crunch and price rises
description: Loss of Yandex capacity raises demand on remaining Russian clouds
evidence_for: Kommersant: strikes threaten rise in cloud prices
Shadayev: ministry working with Defence Ministry on protecting DCs
observable_indicators: Official announcements; visible protective structures on imagery
